description.value: Bella Nonna's is an Italian-inspired artisan bakery, deli, and grocer located in downtown Maple Ridge, BC, handcrafting a wide array of specialty baked goods — breads, cookies, cakes, and pastries — alongside charcuterie boards and gourmet platters. Named after the owner's mother and daughter, the shop celebrates Italian culinary traditions with a community-focused ethos. A touring cyclist stopping here can pick up artisan breads, pastries, and specialty deli items to fuel the road ahead.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bellanonnas.com was successfully fetched and confirms the business is a real, active Italian-inspired artisan bakery, deli, and grocer in downtown Maple Ridge; blog posts from May 2025 confirm it is currently open. The website corroborates the OSM address (11841 224th st) and provides a phone number not present in OSM, while the OSM name 'Bella Nonna's Bakery' differs slightly from the website's branding of 'Bella Nonna's Deli and Grocer.' No evidence for bike parking, water refill, or most cyclist amenities was found anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; the website does self-describe as a 'Grocer' and sells a range of food products including breads, pastries, charcuterie, and platters, supporting a Basic groceries value of true.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bella Nonna's Bakery' but the website consistently brands the business as 'Bella Nonna's Deli and Grocer' or 'Bella Nonna's Deli & Grocer' — the OSM name omits the deli/grocer aspect.
Phone number (604) 467-7875 is present on the website but absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible artisan bakery and grocer in downtown Maple Ridge with a current website and recent blog activity confirming it is open.
